---
# telemetry-datamart-lab: Iceberg + Trino datamart on OpenShift (AWS sandbox)
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Telemetry Datamart Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

# Sandbox credentials: the job assumes this role once, at the start of the run
sandbox_aws_role_name: rhdp-sandbox-provisioner
sandbox_aws_session_duration: 3600

aws_region: us-east-2
control_plane_instance_type: m6i.2xlarge
worker_instance_count: 4
worker_instance_type: m6i.4xlarge
ocp4_installer_version: "4.18"

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_datamart

ocp4_workload_datamart_trino_workers: 3
ocp4_workload_datamart_warehouse_bucket: "rhdp-{{ guid }}-warehouse"
